activities.name: Complete Physical Examination
activities.label: Complete Physical Examination
activities.description:
The complete physical examination excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations
unless clinically indicated.
Assess for TB risk factors and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an
assessment of peripheral lymph nodes (Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.7 of the IIBD master
protocol).

notes.text:
The complete physical examination excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations
unless clinically indicated.
Assess for TB risk factors and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an
assessment of peripheral lymph nodes (Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.7 of the IIBD master
protocol).

activities.name: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment
activities.label: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment
activities.description:
Perform as shown in this schedule and as needed at any visit based on participant status
and standard of care. Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and
visual examination of the skin (Section 8.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol). May be
performed by qualified personnel per local regulations.
Assess for TB risk factors and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an
assessment of peripheral lymph nodes (Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.7 of the IIBD master
protocol).
